_readme: Post flow (Integration) as generated by fuuz/accelerators/teams-shared/post.cjs teamsPostFlow({ connectionName, flowName, lookup: 'name' }). Replace <CONNECTION_NAME> and <FLOW_NAME>.
Every node: logInput / logOutput / logErrors = false. Execution events stay on; they carry no payload.
The HOOK and STRIP transforms are abbreviated here; copy the full text from post.cjs (they validate the URL shape before any HTTP call and scrub URLs / sig= from errors).
tryCatch carries ONLY tryNextNodes and catchNextNodes (a transform key is rejected by the platform).
name: <FLOW_NAME>

data.query: query { c: connection(first: 1, where: { name: { _eq: "<CONNECTION_NAME>" } }) { edges { node { id active url credentials } } } }

nodes.name: Full URL Or Host + Path (secret; raises when not configured)

data.transform: <HOOK from post.cjs: $error('teams webhook connection missing or inactive') | $error('teams webhook not configured') | { hook: { shape: 'full', path: '' } }>
<STRIP from post.cjs: status from the 4xx/5xx in the message; error with sig=, URLs and /powerautomate/ paths replaced, max 300 chars>
